title: Supply Drop
description: This mod adds a customizable supply drop event that can be started by operators using commands. Admins can choose the loot, reveal coordinates after a timer, show a bossbar countdown, and spawn a protected supply drop.
body:
# Supply Drop

Supply Drop is a simple server-side Fabric mod that adds customizable supply drop events to Minecraft.

Operators can start a supply drop at chosen coordinates, fill a custom GUI with any loot they want, and let players fight for the reward once the timer ends. The drop uses a protected barrel, a bossbar countdown.

## Features

- Custom loot GUI for operators
- Supply drops at custom coordinates
- Bossbar countdown with coordinates
- Title announcements for players
- Protected barrel that cannot be broken
- Locked drop before the timer ends
- Automatic removal after opening
- Polish and English command versions
- Timer skip and reset commands for operators

## Commands

### Polish version
- `/zrzut <x> <y> <z>` - starts a supply drop
- `/zrzut skip` - skips the full timer
- `/zrzut skip5` - skips 5 minutes
- `/zrzut reset` - resets the active supply drop

### English version
- `/supplydrop <x> <y> <z>` - starts a supply drop
- `/supplydrop skip` - skips the full timer
- `/supplydrop skip5` - skips 5 minutes
- `/supplydrop reset` - resets the active supply drop

## How it works

After starting a supply drop, players receive an announcement. The coordinates are revealed later, and a bossbar shows the countdown. When the timer ends, the drop becomes available and players can open it to collect the loot.

Perfect for SMP servers, PvP events, Lifesteal servers, factions, and survival events.
